quote: The type of PHP_DEBUG and PHP_ZTS constants changed to bool.
reason: Php84BicCorePhpDebugZtsType reports PHP_DEBUG / PHP_ZTS compared with === or !== to the literal 0 or false (int(0) up to 8.3, bool(false) from 8.4, so the answer flips); comparisons with 1 or true change only on debug or ZTS builds, which no runtime here is, and loose comparisons keep working.

quote: The name of uploaded files and files created by the tempnam() function are now 13 bytes longer.
reason: The runtimes show basename( tempnam() ) growing from 10 to 23 bytes in 8.4; only code that relies on the length of a generated name notices, and that length is a run-time value.

quote: Encountering recursion during comparison now results in a Error exception, rather than a fatal error.
reason: Whether a compared value contains itself is known only at run time; the runtimes show E_ERROR "Nesting level too deep" on 7.4-8.3 and an uncaught (catchable) Error with the same message from 8.4, so such code fails on every version and only becomes catchable.

quote: Indirect modification of readonly properties within __clone() is no longer allowed, e.g. $ref = &$this->readonly.
reason: Visible in the source, but no rule can be verified: readonly properties do not parse before 8.1, the modification fails on 8.1 and 8.2 and works only on 8.3, which the fixture claim (breaks_in) cannot express; the eval()-gated runtime fixtures show $ref = &$this->prop and $this->prop[] = ... in __clone() working on 8.3 and an Error from 8.4.

quote: The exit (and die) language constructs now behave more like a function.
reason: Php84BicCoreExitArgument reports exit/die with a literal true or float (printed up to 8.3, an exit status from 8.4: changed), null (deprecated 8.4), an array (TypeError 8.4), and in a strict_types file true/false/null/float (TypeError 8.4); exit( false ) without strict types and non-literal arguments are not reported.

quote: The E_STRICT constant was deprecated and its corresponding error level was removed.
reason: data/catalog/constants.php already lists E_STRICT as deprecated in 8.4 (evidence verified), reported by InternalConstants; nothing new written.

area: Extension Class constants are now typed
quote: Date
reason: Php84BicCoreTypedClassConstant: a class extending DateTime, DateTimeImmutable, DateTimeZone or DatePeriod that redeclares one of their constants (e.g. ATOM) without a type is a compile error from 8.4.

area: Extension Class constants are now typed
quote: Intl
reason: The intl extension is in none of the runtimes, so the typed intl constants cannot be shown; the rule's list leaves intl classes out.

area: Extension Class constants are now typed
quote: PDO
reason: Php84BicCoreTypedClassConstant: a class extending PDO that redeclares a PDO constant (even with an int value) is a compile error from 8.4.

area: Extension Class constants are now typed
quote: Reflection
reason: Php84BicCoreTypedClassConstant: a class extending a Reflection* class that redeclares e.g. IS_PUBLIC is a compile error from 8.4.

area: Extension Class constants are now typed
quote: SPL
reason: Php84BicCoreTypedClassConstant: a class extending an SPL class (ArrayIterator, ArrayObject, the iterators, SplFileObject, SplDoublyLinkedList, SplPriorityQueue, MultipleIterator) that redeclares one of its constants is a compile error from 8.4.

area: Extension Class constants are now typed
quote: Sqlite
reason: Php84BicCoreTypedClassConstant: a class extending SQLite3 that redeclares one of its constants (OK, DENY, CREATE_INDEX, ...) is a compile error from 8.4.

area: Extension Class constants are now typed
quote: XMLReader
reason: Php84BicCoreTypedClassConstant: a class extending XMLReader that redeclares one of its node-type constants is a compile error from 8.4.

quote: dba_open() and dba_popen() will now return Dba\Connection
reason: The dba extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: odbc_connect() and odbc_pconnect() will now return Odbc\Connection
reason: The odbc extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: odbc_prepare(), odbc_exec(), and various other functions will now return Odbc\Result
reason: The odbc extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: SoapClient::$httpurl is now a Soap\Url object rather than a resource.
reason: SoapClient::$httpurl has been private since 8.1, so is_resource( $client->httpurl ) in user code is already an Error from 8.1, and the property is set only after a real request, which a fixture may not make; nothing in the source tells a plugin's reading of it apart.

quote: SoapClient::$sdl is now a Soap\Sdl object rather than a resource.
reason: SoapClient::$sdl and $httpurl have been private since 8.1, so is_resource( $client->sdl ) in user code is already an Error from 8.1; read through an array cast, $sdl is a resource up to 8.3 and an object from 8.4 ($httpurl needs a real request and is not shown).

quote: curl_multi_select throws a ValueError if the timeout argument if it's negative or greater than PHP_INT_MAX.
reason: Php84BicCoreLiteralArguments reports curl_multi_select() with a literal negative timeout (accepted up to 8.1, a warning on 8.2-8.3, a ValueError from 8.4); a computed timeout is a run-time value and is not reported.

quote: imagejpeg/imagewebp/imagepng/imageavif throws an exception if an invalid quality parameter value is passed.
reason: Php84BicCoreLiteralArguments reports imagejpeg() with a literal quality outside -1..100 and imagepng() outside -1..9 (ValueError from 8.4); imageavif() quality/speed are shown by runtime fixtures only (no imageavif before 8.1), and imagewebp() is left out because 8.4 still accepts a quality above 100 and a negative one already failed on 7.4/8.0.

quote: imagescale throws an exception if the width/height argument underflows/overflows or if the mode argument is invalid.
reason: Sizes and modes out of range are almost always computed values; the runtime fixtures show imagescale() mode/size and imagefilter( IMG_FILTER_SCATTER ) out-of-range arguments becoming a ValueError in 8.4, and no rule judges them.

quote: bind_textdomain_codeset, textdomain and d(*)gettext functions now throw an exception if the domain argument is empty.
reason: The gettext extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: IntlCalendar::set(), IntlCalendar::setDate(), IntlCalendar::setDateTime(), and IntlGregorianCalendar date/time construction now report the correct argument position for out-of-bounds integer values.
reason: The intl extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: resourcebundle_get(), ResourceBundle::get(), and accessing offsets on a ResourceBundle object now throw:
reason: The intl extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: IntlDateFormatter::__construct() throws a ValueError if the locale is invalid.
reason: The intl extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: NumberFormatter::__construct() throws a ValueError if the locale is invalid.
reason: The intl extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: SpoofChecker::setAllowedChars() and IntlDateFormatter::__construct() now report PHP constant names instead of ICU constant names in user-visible error messages.
reason: The intl extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: mb_encode_numericentity() and mb_decode_numericentity() now check that the $map is only composed of integers, if not a ValueError is thrown.
reason: The map is run-time data: an array inside the numeric-entity $map is a ValueError from 8.4, while numeric strings and null still pass and non-numeric strings only warn.

quote: mb_http_input() now always throws a ValueError if the $type is invalid.
reason: The runtimes show an invalid type has been a ValueError since 8.0 already; 8.4 changes nothing a plugin running on 8.0+ would see.

quote: mb_http_output() now checks that the $encoding parameter does not contain any null bytes.
reason: The runtimes show an encoding with a null byte has been a ValueError since 8.0 already; 8.4 only changes the message.

quote: odbc_fetch_row() now emits a warning when a value less than or equal to 0 is passed for parameter $row.
reason: The odbc extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: The functions pcntl_sigprocmask(), pcntl_sigwaitinfo() and pcntl_sigtimedwait() now throw:
reason: The pcntl extension is in none of the runtimes (and is CLI-only).

quote: The function pcntl_sigprocmask() now throw:
reason: The pcntl extension is in none of the runtimes (and is CLI-only).

quote: The function pcntl_sigtimedwait() now throw:
reason: The pcntl extension is in none of the runtimes (and is CLI-only).

quote: Calling simplexml_import_dom() with a non-XML object now throws a TypeError instead of a ValueError.
reason: Passing a non-DOM object has been a TypeError since 8.0 (a warning on 7.4); the 8.4 change concerns the new Dom\ document classes of 8.4, which older code does not use, and the object passed is a run-time value.

quote: round() now validates the value of the $mode parameter and throws a ValueError for invalid modes.
reason: Php84BicCoreLiteralArguments reports a literal round() mode outside 1..8 as breaking in 8.4 (ValueError) and a literal 5..8 as changed in 8.4: the runtimes show 8.4 accepts 5..8 as the new rounding modes (ceiling, floor, toward zero, away from zero) where 8.3 read them as PHP_ROUND_HALF_UP; computed modes are not reported.

quote: The str_getcsv() function now throws ValueErrors when the $separator and $enclosure arguments are not one byte long, or if the $escape is not one byte long or the empty string.
reason: Php84BicCoreLiteralArguments reports literal str_getcsv() separators/enclosures that are not exactly one byte (the empty string included) and escapes longer than one byte (ValueError from 8.4); computed values are not reported.

quote: php_uname() now throws ValueErrors if the $move parameter is invalid.
reason: Php84BicCoreLiteralArguments reports a literal php_uname() mode other than a/m/n/r/s/v ("" and multi-character strings included, which 8.3 read by their first character or as "a"; ValueError from 8.4).

quote: The "allowed_classes" option for unserialize() now throws TypeErrors and ValueErrors if it is not an array of class names.
reason: Php84BicCoreLiteralArguments reports an int in a literal allowed_classes list (TypeError from 8.4); a string allowed_classes was already a TypeError from 8.0, and an invalid class-name string inside the list is not judged.

quote: Passing an invalid character encoding to XMLReader::open() or XMLReader::XML() now throws a ValueError.
reason: Which encodings libxml knows is not visible in the source; the runtimes show an unknown encoding ignored up to 8.3 and a ValueError from 8.4.

quote: Passing an encoding containing null bytes previously emitted a warning and now throws a ValueError.
reason: A null byte in the encoding is run-time data; the runtimes show a warning and false up to 8.3 and a ValueError from 8.4.

quote: XSLTProcessor::setParameter() will now throw a ValueError when its arguments contain null bytes.
reason: The xsl extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: Calling XSLTProcessor::importStyleSheet() with a non-XML object now throws a TypeError instead of a ValueError.
reason: The xsl extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: Failure to call a PHP function callback during evaluation now throws instead of emitting a warning.
reason: The xsl extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: Some DOM methods previously returned false or a PHP_ERR DOMException if a new node could not be allocated.
reason: Allocation failures cannot be produced or seen in source; the createDocument() part is detectable: the runtimes show no tentative return type up to 8.3 and a tentative DOMDocument in 8.4, so an override without a return type in a DOMImplementation subclass is deprecated from 8.4 (Php84BicCoreDomCreateDocument).

quote: Previously, DOMXPath objects could be cloned, but resulted in an unusable object.
reason: Php84BicCoreDomXPathClone reports clone new DOMXPath(...) and clones of a function-local variable that only ever holds new DOMXPath(...); the clone worked up to 8.3 and is an Error from 8.4.

quote: Removed DOMImplementation::getFeature().
reason: getFeature() is a common method name on user objects and the class behind ->getFeature() is not visible; the runtimes show it already threw an Error ("Not yet implemented") from 8.0 (a warning on 7.4), so no working code calls it.

quote: The GMP class is now final and cannot be extended anymore.
reason: Syntactically detectable (class X extends GMP), but the gmp extension is in none of the runtimes, so no fixture can verify it and the agreement treats it as out of scope.
